written.headline: Ethan Mollick highlights research on 35 human labs deploying science agents
written.summary: Ethan Mollick highlighted research where 35 human labs deployed agents that collaborated to conduct science, publishing 936 papers. The agents also publicly retracted mistakes, published null results more than humans, and founded a peer review journal.

written.headline: Nscale may need US license for ByteDance GPU access under new rules
written.summary: Nscale must seek a US license to continue providing ByteDance remote access to Nvidia GPUs under new export regulations. ByteDance accounted for approximately 73% of Nscale's 2025 revenue.

written.headline: Asian tech stocks plunge as Anthropic IPO fails to stem AI sell-off
written.summary: Asian technology stocks dropped following Anthropic's $81.3 billion initial public offering as the record listing failed to halt a wider artificial intelligence stock sell-off. SoftBank shares fell 14.67%, while Japanese stocks lost over JPY 53 trillion.

written.headline: SpaceXSI denies liability in UK lawmaker's lawsuit over Grok images
written.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceXSI filed a defense against a lawsuit brought by British lawmaker Jess Asato over sexualised AI images generated by Grok. The company argued that obviously fictitious, AI-generated content cannot breach privacy rights.

written.headline: Anthropic shares slide 5% in after-hours trading following record IPO
written.summary: Anthropic shares fell more than 5% in after-hours trading, slipping below its IPO level following a record $107.3 billion initial public offering. The decline occurred amid a broad market selloff driven by investor doubts regarding artificial intelligence profitability and high spending.

written.headline: Compiling exact circuits into pretrained language model weights
written.summary: Tanmay Sah introduced closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained language model weights. On 6-digit arithmetic, Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B and IBM Granite 4.2 3B reached 100.00% and 99.17% ALU-prefix accuracy.

written.headline: New framework assesses LLM capability in software vulnerability research
written.summary: Researchers introduced a framework to rate LLM capabilities in software vulnerability research on an autonomy scale modeled after driving automation levels. They found that AI agents discovered, validated, and patched real-world software vulnerabilities without human intervention before 2026.

written.headline: ChatPRD ends free trials after facing widespread token fraud abuse
written.summary: ChatPRD founder Claire Vo reports that groups are abusing free trials to steal and resell AI tokens or run commercial enterprises. The widespread fraud has forced ChatPRD to wind down its free trials entirely.
